question: Has a published erratum/correction been issued against any U23/S16 trial report, and does it touch the served number?
method: commentCorrectionList of every held Europe PMC core record (36 unique PMIDs across U23 and S16), 2026-09-25; each erratum acquired where possible

population.denominator: unique trial-report PMIDs behind the U23 and S16 rows

rows.content: procedures section: tranexamic acid '10 mg/mL' should have been '100 mg/mL'
rows.touches_served_number: NO (verified from the held erratum text)

rows.content: NOT HELD: publisher page 403, PubMed has no text. An unverified web-search summary says it corrects the acute-pancreatitis placebo rate in Table 1 (0.11 -> 0.06 per 100 person-yr); not used as evidence
rows.touches_served_number: UNRESOLVED (the served HHF HR is unlikely to be affected if the summary is right)

rows.content: NOT HELD: publisher page 403, PubMed has no text
rows.touches_served_number: UNRESOLVED; the served row is the REGISTRY's arm means (NCT02418585), not the paper's, so a paper erratum cannot change it directly

limit: only corrections Europe PMC links to the report are found; an uncited correction or a registry results update would not appear
